blocks.text: The Tag Management page allows you to configure tag data, such as namespaces, keys, and values. After a tag is fully configured with those data components, you can assign the tag to resource groups. To learn more, see About Resource Groups.
The Tag Management page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Configure, edit, and delete tag configuration data.
View a summary of tag configuration data in your organization.
Discover insights about collective resource tag data.

blocks.text: On the Tag Management page (Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Tag Management), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click a namespace to display its tag data.
Search for a tag key or value from the configured namespace.
View a list of all tags configured for your namespace.
Click an individual tag key to view its Tag Details.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
